text:
marie_cs: Quick sync — just finished onboarding call with NorthBay. They love the embeddings but raised 3 asks and one renewal flag. Posting raw notes so we can triage.

sasha_pm: thanks — can you paste the asks?

marie_cs: sure. TL;DR: (1) per-route billing visibility (asks for route-level cost breakdown in UI), (2) cheaper small-batch inference mode for dev teams, (3) better webhook retry logs. Renewal flag: billing surprise on first invoice made CFO nervous.

dan_product: can you paste the customer's quote for the billing bit? that's useful for PRD later.

marie_cs: quote: ```
"We got a $5k bill in week 1 and we can't explain why — engineers are blocked without per-route cost. If this repeats, we'll pause contract renewal talks."
```

aj_support: re: webhook retries — we currently log retry_count and last_status in event logs but not surfaced in UI. Easy short-term: add a debug toggle in alerts or a permalink into logs. Medium-term: surface retry history per webhook.

evan_eng: small-batch inference mode: depends on model and infra. We have a batching knob but it trades latency/cost. If we add a prescriptive "dev-mode" that reduces max-batch-size and enables KV-cache less aggressively, we can shave costs for tiny dev loads. Rough estimate: 2-3 sprints to prototype + 1 sprint to productize.

sasha_pm: sounds like three buckets: quick UI/reporting change for billing visibility, product-mode for dev-batching (mid-term), and logs UX for webhooks (short). Prioritize based on renewal risk.

marie_cs: I recommend: Billing visibility = P0 for NorthBay (renewal at risk), Webhook logs = P1 (support burden), Dev-batch mode = P2 (nice-to-have).

dan_product: agree. I'll create a short PRD for Billing Visibility and link customer quote. Assigning owners: dan -> Billing Visibility PRD + metrics, evan -> feasibility + prototype for dev-mode, aj_support -> webhook logs UX + short-term permalink.

onboarding-bot: Transcript + recording uploaded: https://redwood-recordings/company/4795012345/northbay-onboard-2026-03-23.mp4

marie_cs: Thanks. Action items: 1) @dan_product create PRD by EOD Wed, include cost delta examples and a mock UI with per-route toggle. 2) @evan_eng draft prototype plan with perf/cost tradeoffs by next Tue. 3) @aj_support add support workaround steps to KB and send to customer (marie will own outreach).

sasha_pm: FYI I'll slot Billing Visibility into roadmap candidate list and loop in finance analytics for a sample export schema.

marie_cs: I reached out to customer already and offered temporary manual export + a short call with finance to walk the bill. They accepted — should buy us 2 weeks. Will update renewal flag in Gainsight after PRD.

dan_product: one more ask — can we capture sample invoice and annotate which tokens/routes caused spikes? even a CSV export helps.

aj_support: if they can share last invoice + request IDs we can map traces. I'll send an email template.

marie_cs: ok looping back — I put this thread on the CS weekly agenda and added a Notion page: https://redwood.notion/s/cs-feedback/northbay-billing-visibility-4795012345 (will populate after PRD).

evan_eng: noted. If we need a quick spike I can allocate 20% for next sprint to prototype dev-mode.

marie_cs: great team, thanks. Please mark updates here so I can update renewal status. :thumbsup:
